paper-main-classification: Nature Communications Results and Figure 2: Pax2 was highly expressed in I1-I7; I8 lacked Pax2 but shared Mpped2 with the other interneuron clusters and was initially described as a suspected rare cholinergic interneuron.

paper-methods-sample-frame: Nature Communications Methods, Single nucleus isolation and sequencing: 12 eight-week-old mice (6 female, 6 male), matching regions pooled from two mice, and three processing replicates comprising male, female, and mixed-sex tissue.
